newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P affirms TDK's AA- corporate rating.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms TDK's AA- corporate rating.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Monday it had affirmed the ratings of TDK Corp and related entities.

The ratings affirmed included the parent's AA- corporate credit rating and stable outlook, and the A1+ short-term rating on TDK USA Corp's U.S. commercial paper programme, which benefits from a keepwell letter from the parent.
At the same time, S&P said it has withdrawn its short-term ratings on TDK International Netherlands BV's Euro commercial paper programmes following their termination.
